key_catalysts: Saudi East-West pipeline restart this week
Iran Hormuz report; Zelensky meeting today
brief.summary: Stocks are near record highs with S&P futures slightly higher, while Treasury yields fall across the curve and the curve flattens. Brent drops below $100 for a fifth session on reports Iran may reopen Hormuz and Saudi's East-West pipeline restarts, easing inflation pressure. The Fed remains hawkish: last week's hike may be followed by one or two more, with Williams speaking later. AI optimism is a major equity support as Meta's agent and Alibaba's chip revive the hardware trade. Credit dispersion is widening in triple-Cs, and diesel costs remain a political and consumer pain point. The show's tone is cautiously risk-on, though Fed and energy risks temper it.
notable_quotes: The only way back is the hard way.
